preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and 1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_lines if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case's length n is an integer between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(line) for line in stdin_lines if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin_lines if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each string s has length exactly equal to its corresponding n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '+-' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin_lines if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of characters '+' and '-'.

postconditions.expression:
stdout == '
'.join(str(count_promising_substrings(s)) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin_lines if not line.strip().isdigit()]) + '
'
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is the count of all non-empty promising substrings of s, each counted as many times as it occurs in s.

postconditions.expression: all(count_promising_substrings(s) == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1) if is_promising(s[i:j])) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin_lines if not line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: The count of promising substrings is computed by summing 1 for every non-empty substring that is promising.
